## Answer

**Definition used:** transcription factors = genes whose HPA `Protein class` contains "Transcription factors"; "cell type enriched RNA expression" = HPA `RNA single cell type specificity` = **"Cell type enriched"**. The specific single cell type is given by the HPA `RNA single cell type specific nCPM` field (e.g. "Neutrophils: 4633.5").

**Total:** 92 transcription factors have cell-type-enriched RNA expression.

### Bar chart — 15 cell types with the most cell-type-enriched transcription factors

```

Late spermatids             ██████ 6
Oocytes                     ██████ 6
Cardiomyocytes              █████ 5
Early spermatids            █████ 5
Adrenal medulla cells       ███ 3

Tuft cells                  ███ 3

Early primary spermatocytes ██ 2
Epididymal principal cells  ██ 2
Extravillous trophoblasts   ██ 2
Hepatocytes                 ██ 2
Myosatellite cells          ██ 2
Neuroendocrine cells        ██ 2
```

*(Note: 12 other cell types also have 2 TFs each — Pancreatic acinar cells, Platelets, Prostatic glandular cells, Retinal bipolar cells, Thymic myoid cells, etc. — so the 15th place is a tie and the exact 15th entry depends on ordering.)*

### Cell type with the most: **Neutrophils (8 transcription factors)**

| Gene | nCPM | RNA tissue specificity | Validated prognostic (TCGA) |
|------|------|------------------------|------------------------------|
| ELF2 | 4633.5 | Low tissue specificity | Yes — Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma, favorable (p=6.79e-6; validation p=1.04e-5) |
| NFKBIZ | 3464.1 | Tissue enriched | No |
| BCL6 | 2731.6 | Tissue enhanced | No |
| STAT5B | 1497.8 | Low tissue specificity | Yes — Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma, favorable (p=1.27e-8; validation p=1.44e-5) |
| ZNF438 | 1433.6 | Low tissue specificity | No |
| ZNF429 | 489.9 | Low tissue specificity | Yes — Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma, favorable (p=2.80e-4; validation p=1.39e-4) |
| ZNF281 | 385.3 | Tissue enhanced | No |
| ZNF746 | 109.4 | Low tissue specificity | No |

**RNA tissue specificity distribution (bar chart):**
```
Low tissue specificity  █████ 5   (ELF2, STAT5B, ZNF438, ZNF429, ZNF746)
Tissue enhanced         ██ 2      (BCL6, ZNF281)
Tissue enriched         █ 1       (NFKBIZ)
```

**Validated prognostic association in any TCGA cohort:** 3 of the 8 — **ELF2, STAT5B, ZNF429** — all with a *validated favorable* prognostic association in **Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)** (each also confirmed in the KIRC validation cohort). The other five (NFKBIZ, BCL6, ZNF438, ZNF281, ZNF746) have no validated prognostic association.
